events.title: Ship Miner is part of Prismatic 2026 Indie Showcase!
events.summary: Ship Miner is part of the Prismatic Indie Showcase 2026 edition and will also be part of October Steam Next Fest. I would've loved to have a demo update for the showcase but I couldn't since I am working super hard to for the next fest and the EA release. events.title: Making runs feel more different and indirect combat.
events.summary: While I am preparing the game for EA release, I am tackling some big issues and unknowns to then focus on adding more content and polishing the game. In this blogpost in particular I want to talk about making runs feel more different and changing the combat to be more indirect.One of the issues is that the game feels a bit repetitive in some decisions during the run. events.title: Metagame and replayability with new Ships
events.summary: To prepare for EA release I started working on adding more replayability through metagame unlocks. Having different ships sounds like a reasonable first thing to have in a game named “Ship” Miner.In order to increase replayability, playing with a new ship should provide a different experience when playing the game again. events.title: Ship Miner Demo - Small Update - 0.7.8
events.summary: A small Quality of Life update.* Added: show saved asteroid information in continue button. * Added: ship teleport in/out sfx when coming to asteroid and leaving. * Changed: added again the try again button when ship destroyed, it restarts the level with all savegame data. * Changed: continue game will start in the same asteroid when quit was selected. * Changed: increased mining speed stat max levels to 8 and increment per level to 20% from 15%.

events.title: Ship Miner Demo Update - 0.7.7

Also increased a bit the current game difficulty.There is still a lot to do, I hope I can focus on adding more content for next update (enemies, tech, etc) while also tune a bit all the asteroid travel progression too.Thanks so much for reading! Hope you enjoy it!PLAY IT NOW!

events.title: Ship Miner Demo Released!!!
events.summary: I’ve just released the Demo of Ship Miner!!!
